paper.title_en: Characteristic gluing to extremal Kerr horizons and the third law of black hole thermodynamics in vacuum
paper.abstract_en: We prove a non-perturbative, non-axisymmetric characteristic gluing theorem for the Einstein vacuum equations: every Boyer-Lindquist sphere in the domain of outer communication of a Kerr black hole, in particular every symmetry sphere of a Schwarzschild exterior, can be glued along a single outgoing null hypersurface to a horizon sphere of an extremal Kerr black hole of sufficiently large mass. The gluing is exact at both ends and matches the full sphere data, including the transversal curvature. This proves a conjecture of Kehle and Unger in the extremal case. We first raise the angular momentum to the extremal value by rotating shear pulses of non-axisymmetric gravitational radiation, and then damp the incoming data exponentially along a long non-expanding neck. At the degenerate target horizon we invert the linearised problem at all angular frequencies, using a factorisation of a fourth-order angular operator into an angular Teukolsky-Starobinsky product. As an application, we construct one-ended asymptotically flat vacuum initial data whose maximal development contains an exactly Schwarzschild apparent horizon and, at a later advanced time, an exactly extremal Kerr event horizon. This is the first rigorous counterexample to the third law of black hole thermodynamics in vacuum, and proves a second conjecture of Kehle and Unger.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文证明了极端Kerr视界的非微扰、非轴对称特征拼接定理，并据此构造出真空Einstein方程中第一个严格的第三定律黑洞热力学反例，直接回应了Kehle-Unger的两个猜想；理论深度高，方法（角向Teukolsky-Starobinsky因子化、剪切脉冲与指数衰减颈部）具体且可检验，对黑洞热力学与广义相对论基础均有实质意义。论文仅2天，零引用为中性，不扣分。
decision.title_zh: 到极端Kerr视界的特征拼接与真空中黑洞热力学第三定律
decision.abstract_zh: 我们证明了Einstein真空方程的一个非微扰、非轴对称特征拼接定理：Kerr黑洞外通信区域中的每个Boyer-Lindquist球面，尤其是Schwarzschild外部时空的每个对称球面，都可以沿单个出射零超曲面拼接到一个质量足够大的极端Kerr黑洞的视界球面上。该拼接在两端都是精确的，并且匹配完整的球面数据，包括横向曲率。这证明了Kehle与Unger在极端情形下的一个猜想。我们首先通过非轴对称引力辐射的旋转剪切脉冲把角动量提升到极端值，然后沿一条长的非膨胀颈部对入射数据作指数衰减。在退化目标视界处，我们利用一个四阶角向算子分解为角向Teukolsky-Starobinsky乘积，对所有角频率反演了线性化问题。作为应用，我们构造了单端渐近平坦的真空初始数据，其极大发展包含一个精确的Schwarzschild视界，并在之后的一个推迟时刻包含一个精确的极端Kerr事件视界。这是真空中对黑洞热力学第三定律的第一个严格反例，并证明了Kehle与Unger的第二个猜想。
